Roles & Responsibilities
Job Description (Class 3/4 driver):
· Providing delivery services.
· Delivery of goods to outlets, commercial,residential, and industrial areas (Clustered).
· Pick and Pack of goods onto pallets.
· Loading and unloading.
· Other ad hoc duties as assigned.
Job Responsibilities (Class 3/4 driver):
· Ensure safe handling of goods.
· Practice safe driving.
· Observe Safe Work Procedures while delivering goods to Customers.
· Comply with Traffic rules and regulations.
· Familiar with Singapore roads is an added advantage.
· Ensure Vehicle is taken care of in terms of cleanliness, Maintenance and condition.
